profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs consumer hardware, software, and services. Its AI-focused web presence centers on Apple Intelligence and a next-generation version of Siri, which the company describes as "truly helpful AI that's centered around you and your needs" and as "integrated into your apps, grounded in your context, and private at every step." According to the site, these features are coming to iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27, with an initial English-language beta planned for later this year, though the company notes Siri AI will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS.

Apple Intelligence is the underlying system powering Siri AI, enabling open-ended questions, natural back-and-forth conversation, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, writing drafts and feedback, Shortcuts automation from plain-language descriptions, and visual queries using screenshots or Apple Pencil. The company emphasizes on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute as the basis for its privacy positioning. Apple also tracks AI capabilities in Final Cut Pro and iMovie, both described as using on-device processing optimized for Apple silicon.

Apple is a publicly traded company on the ticker AAPL with SEC CIK 0000320193. Its most recently filed 10-K reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025. No litigation is recorded in the held facts. Two MCP servers are associated with Apple in the registry: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking.
